effect_description_eng:
[Start of Your Main Phase] [On Play] 1 of your yellow Digimon gains ＜Barrier＞ (When this Digimon would be deleted in battle, by trashing the top card of your security stack, prevent that deletion.) until the end of your opponent's turn.
[Your Turn] When one of your Digimon is played or digivolves, if it has the [Angel], [Archangel] or [Three Great Angels] trait, by suspending this Tamer, gain 1 memory.
inherited_effect_description_eng: Security Effect [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
